reasons: Both texts tell of the change of qibla from Bayt al-Maqdis to the Ka'ba, quote the same verse, and describe worshippers turning while bowing after someone passes by.

The details of the scene conflict. In A the worshippers are in the 'Asr prayer and a man who prayed with the Prophet passes 'a people of the Ansar'. In B they are in the Fajr prayer, have already prayed one rak'a, and the passer-by is a man of Banu Salima who calls out that the qibla has changed.
A careful reader could take these as variant tellings of one event or as two separate incidents of the same event, so the outcome is contested.
